# Salvager of Ruin (M20).
# "Sacrifice this creature: Choose target permanent card in your graveyard that was put there
#  from the battlefield this turn. Return it to your hand."
# Cost: the sacrifice-self CostSacrifice of Obsessive Stitcher (B5c-cost-ub-sacrifice-return).
# Effect: Fungal Rebirth's "Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand."
# (B5b-return-cards-hand: IS_PERMANENT, CR 110.1 type test) with the per-candidate history filter
# MOVED_TO_ZONE_THIS_TURN (Necromentia's per-card shape in templates_b5b): this card moved from
# the battlefield (anyone's: the text does not restrict it) to your graveyard this turn.
salvage = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(
        parts=(
            CostSacrifice(
                target=Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT),
                    FAtom(
                        pred=FAtomPred.MOVED_TO_ZONE_THIS_TURN,
                        who=ControllerRef.YOU,
                        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
                        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
        ),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    }),
)
abilities = [salvage, *compiled]
